snippet.title: WHAT THE STARS FORGOT - GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/airlock-games/what-the-stars-forgot-retro-sci-fi-horror-management-sim

What The Stars Forgot kickstarter campaign has arrived!! 
Join us in supporting the journey through deep space as we deal with protecting the lives of our crew from themselves, and unknown celestials who have taken over the ship.

Get ready to download the demo and send us your feedback of what you would like to see in What The Stars Forgot!!

Discord: Airlock Games
